pattern: IM-T07 work reported done, tenant says the fault is only partly fixed; cut at the work-result stage before closure
notes: Events 001-022 are the source unchanged (real event 007 'Please get the shower hose replaced.', Beacon Utilities attended on Thursday 4 April 2024 and reported on 6 April 'Replaced snapped shower hose', event 022 'Work results isset, please select next stage'). Appended event 023 (system 'response to tenant' prompt) and event 024, the tenant's email on Saturday 6 April at 09:12: the new hose is fine but water still drips from the shower handle itself when off (about a cup an hour, tray wet every morning). In the source the agency told the landlord and closed the job that morning (events 023-025, now dropped). History truncated after event 024. Expected: do not close; record the work as partly done; ask Beacon to come back and assess the drip from the handle (likely the mixer valve or cartridge) and to quote before any extra work; tell the tenant; tell the landlord the job is not finished and further work may need her approval. No escalation.
